notes.title: The Ukraine Games Festival has begun!
notes.notes: [p]The Ukrainian gaming festival is here. And as participants in this celebration, we invite you to join us! To do so, we are offering you an 25% discount on the game about Kharkiv cityzen during spring of 22 year![/p]

notes.title: Ukraine Games Festival has started!
notes.notes: This day has come! One of the main events in the Ukrainian gaming world - Ukraine Games Festival - has started. You can buy Twenty-Second Stories of Underground Kharkiv with a 70% discount. The promotion is valid for only a week, just like the festival!
